Knighthood and Damehood

VALUE FOR VALUE MODEL (2012 – 2XXX)

As you know, Canary Cry News Talk operates on the Value-for-Value Model. Rather than exposing our listeners to a single second of air-time to the Corporate Interests of “Stakeholder-Capitalism” (see: The Great Reset) we believe that true independent media is only possible when it is completely divorced from the manipulative economic incentives of corporations. That is why the Canary Cry Roundtable exists; to recognize and Honor those on the Noble pursuit to support true, independent media.
